name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs attention across the cemeteries, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each line cites its rule in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, subject, issue from compliance_issues order by rule, subject

sections.title: Interments booked
sections.sql: select to_char(scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as at, deceased, kind, plot, funeral_director, case when paperwork_on is null then 'missing' else 'on file' end as paperwork from schedule order by scheduled_at

sections.title: Rights lapsing or ended
sections.sql: select plot, holder, lapses_on, term_ends_on from right_lapses where space_left > 0 and least(lapses_on, coalesce(term_ends_on, lapses_on)) <= current_date + setting_int('right_lapse_notice_days') order by 3

sections.title: Accounts overdue
sections.sql: select kind, name, overdue_cents, days_overdue, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from arrears order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Grounds jobs open
sections.sql: select s.name as section, g.category, g.reported_on, g.summary from grounds_jobs g join sections s on s.id = g.section_id where g.resolved_on is null order by g.reported_on

name: capacity
title: Capacity
subtitle: Plots available, reserved and in use by section, and how long they last at last year's rate

sections.title: By section
sections.sql: select cemetery, section, section_kind as kind, plots, available, reserved, in_use, unusable, burials_last_year, case when burials_last_year = 0 then null else round(available::numeric / burials_last_year, 1) end as years_left from capacity order by cemetery, section

sections.title: Plots available to sell
sections.sql: select label as plot, plot_type as type, capacity from plot_status ps join cemeteries c on c.id = ps.cemetery_id where ps.status = 'available' and c.closed_on is null order by label

sections.title: Plots out of use
sections.sql: select label as plot, unusable_reason as reason from plot_status where status = 'unusable' order by label

name: memorials
title: Memorials
subtitle: Permits waiting, memorials installed without a permit, and safety inspections

sections.title: Permits waiting
sections.sql: select ps.label as plot, m.applicant, m.description, m.applied_on, current_date - m.applied_on as days_waiting from memorials m join plot_status ps on ps.plot_id = m.plot_id where m.decision is null and m.applied_on is not null order by m.applied_on

sections.title: Unsafe or leaning
sections.sql: select ps.label as plot, m.description, m.condition, m.inspected_on from memorials m join plot_status ps on ps.plot_id = m.plot_id where m.condition in ('unsafe', 'leaning') order by m.condition desc, m.inspected_on

sections.title: Not inspected in two years
sections.sql: select ps.label as plot, m.description, coalesce(m.inspected_on::text, 'never') as last_inspected from memorials m join plot_status ps on ps.plot_id = m.plot_id where m.installed_on is not null and (m.inspected_on is null or m.inspected_on < current_date - 730) order by ps.label
